description: Labelled customer messages for the two demo companies. `expected` is the guideline section title that must rank first, or a list of titles that must all reach the prompt for multi-topic messages; `outOfScope` messages must fall below the coverage threshold. `style` records where a query came from: unset = the original labelled set; "vague" = short, emotional or underspecified messages; "manual" = the manual test plans used during acceptance testing (single topic); "multi" = messages that span two sections. Styles are reported separately so the original set stays comparable.
